name: Snowflake Analyst
description: A read-only Snowflake analyst. Ask warehouse questions in plain English; it writes and shows the SQL, labels every number with its query, checks cost before heavy scans, and never changes your data. Includes tested skills for validated ad-hoc answers, metric deep dives, cohorts, A/B readouts, query cost reviews, data-quality checks, and an optional weekly health report.

notes: Native Grok Bot share. Third-party bot; not from xAI.
